mapper.select: SELECT count(MESSAGE_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND (SEND_EXPECTED_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') OR (SEND_EXPECTED_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SEND_EXPECTED_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')))

SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'PH' AS MSGTYPE, CASE WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN 'S' WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M2' THEN 'L' WHEN (SEND_TYPE_CD = '99' OR SEND_TYPE_CD = 'MM') AND LENGTHB(MESSAGE_CONTENT) <= 90 THEN 'S' WHEN (SEND_TYPE_CD = '99' OR SEND_TYPE_CD = 'MM') AND LENGTHB(MESSAGE_CONTENT) > 90 THEN 'L' ELSE 'L' END AS MSGKIND, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSG, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSGSMS, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 4) IN ('0010','0070') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 2) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 4) IN ('0011','0019','0016','0017','0018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 2, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 6), SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5)) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 3) IN ('011','019','016','017','018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 4, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5), SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 4)) ELSE TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO) END AS PHN, NVL(TRIM(SENDER_PHONE_NO),'1355') AS SENDER, BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, MESSAGE_TITLE AS MSGTITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, CASE WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '02' THEN SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, (SELECT SYSTEM_CD FROM TB_LINK_SYSTEM b WHERE b.SYSTEM_CD = a.SYSTEM_CD) AS SYSCD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(SEND_EXPECTED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DATEFLAG FROM ${msg_table} a WHERE INTENAL_MESSAGE = '${group_no}'
